mapper.sql: id, flow_code, flow_name, definition_id, flow_version, business_type, business_id, business_no, title, initiator_id, initiator_name, current_node_code, current_node_name, variable, flow_status, activity_status, start_at, end_at, duration_ms, status, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, parent_instance_id, parent_node_code, due_at
mapper.update:
UPDATE ydsz_flow_instance
flow_status = #{flowStatus}, current_node_code = #{currentNodeCode}, current_node_name = #{currentNodeName}, end_at = #{endAt}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, updated_by = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE ydsz_flow_instance SET variable = #{variable}, updated_by = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE ydsz_flow_instance SET due_at = #{dueAt}, updated_by = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ydsz_flow_instance WHERE due_at IS NOT NULL AND due_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND flow_status = 'RUNNING' AND parent_instance_id IS NOT NULL AND status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY due_at ASC
SELECT flow_status AS "flowStatus", COUNT(1) AS "cnt" FROM ydsz_flow_instance WHERE status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY flow_status

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN start_at >= CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "todayNewCount", SUM(CASE WHEN end_at >= CURRENT_DATE AND end_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "todayCompletedCount" FROM ydsz_flow_instance WHERE status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ydsz_flow_instance WHERE definition_id = #{definitionId} AND flow_status = 'RUNNING' AND status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted = 0

SELECT current_node_code AS "currentNodeCode", MAX(current_node_name) AS "currentNodeName", COUNT(1) AS "cnt" FROM ydsz_flow_instance WHERE definition_id = #{definitionId} AND flow_status = 'RUNNING' AND status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted = 0 AND current_node_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY current_node_code ORDER BY cnt DESC

SELECT i.id AS "id", i.flow_code AS "flowCode", i.flow_name AS "flowName", i.business_type AS "businessType", i.business_id AS "businessId", i.start_at AS "startAt" FROM ydsz_flow_instance i WHERE i.flow_status = 'RUNNING' AND i.status = 'ENABLED' AND i.deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ydsz_flow_run_task t WHERE t.instance_id = i.id AND t.task_status IN ('PENDING', 'CLAIMED') AND t.status = 'ENABLED' AND t.deleted = 0 ) ORDER BY i.start_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
